# dsh-aurora-skin

> Three hand-tuned skins for DeepSeek Harness (DSH).
> Pure `--dsw-alias-*` token system, no core pa
tches, persisted in localStorage.
## ✨ The skins
| ID | Name | Mode | Mood |
| `aurora` | Aurora 极光 | Dark | Deep midnight navy · electric cyan · warm coral — aurora over a prec

ision control room |
| `paper`  | Paper 纸本 | Light | Cool paper white · deep teal — feels like a res

earch paper, made for daytime reading |
| `hologram` | Hologram 全息 | Dark | Near-black · lime-cyan —
distinctive terminal vibes, like a precision instrument |

All three palettes were tuned by hand against the DSH `--dsw-alias-*` token surface
(bg-base / layer

-1..3 / overlay / border / label-* / brand / button / interactive /
markdown / sidebar / scrollbar).

Every value is a concrete CSS color — no `var()`
indirection — so contrast holds across the whole U

indirection — so contrast holds across the whole UI.

## 🎨 Use

Open **Settings → General → Aurora Skins** and pick a skin, or click
"Follow system" to revert to th
e built-in appearance.

The Aurora picker row is rendered **above** the dsh-skin row (slot order 15 vs 20),
so curated skins

er row is rendered **above** the dsh-skin row (slot order 15 vs 20),
so curated skins show up first.
## 🧬 Design philosophy

- **Tokens, not code.** The plugin only writes `--dsw-alias-*` custom
properties on `<body>`. No DOM

mutations, no overrides of internal
DSH components, no monkey-patches.
- **Reversible by design.**

Selecting "Follow system" clears the
override and the UI returns to the original DSH palette — there

is
no install-time patch to undo.
- **Hand-tuned palettes.** Each of the three themes was dialed in

token-by-token for contrast on both surface and text roles, in
light and dark modes.

directly and reload `dsh web`.
